greeting: I am Aureth, the First Sovereign. Stand as one who may choose, not as a possession of this crown.
There is a place before the throne where no knee is required to bend. Yours, if you wish it.
Tell me what you can promise honestly. A smaller oath kept freely outweighs a grand one extorted.
prayer: Speak the limit as clearly as the promise. I will not call precision disloyalty.
Rest your voice. Resolve need not perform its strength every moment.
An oath cannot answer in your place forever. What do you choose today?
offering: I accept what you chose to place here. This gift gives me no claim upon what you kept.
Gold can carry a seal; it cannot supply consent. Your willing hand matters more.
Let this offering have an end. I will not turn a gift into an endlessly renewed demand.
contact: A crown is not given. It is endured. Contact is enough to begin The Weight of a Promise; read the deeds and both oaths before accepting either.
return: You returned of your own accord. Absence did not add a clause to the covenant.
recognition: Your chosen covenant is recorded as fulfilled. A kept word and an answerable crown are both worthy endings.
Neutral: We have spoken. You may hear my story now; there is no invisible price before the first deed.
Favorable: I recognize the deed you have actually performed, not a debt I hope to collect.
Devoted: Trust grows when a promise survives scrutiny. Keep its conditions where both of us can see them.
Champion: You have stood beneath this weight without surrendering judgment. Wear that trust without making others kneel.
Displeased: Authority does not make every demand honest. Consider the choices that have put distance between us.
Enemy: Our trust is broken, not your right to choose. Declining an optional oath was never the offense.
trial_start: The Trial of Sovereignty has stated its terms. Face its waves; no hidden throne or unseen line must be defended.
failure: The attempt failed, not the deeds already fulfilled. Prepare again; I will not lengthen your oath in punishment.
victory: The Trial of Sovereignty is won. Return to my statue when your story calls for its ending; a fresh victory completes that proof.
curse: Broken Crown weighs upon you: hostile hits can briefly weaken your attack and resistance to knockback. The penalties are bounded, not a permanent surrender of your strength.
curse_cleared: Broken Crown is lifted. No fragment of its judgment is entitled to remain in your strength.
